name: comments
label: Comments
description: An array of the comments to display.

name: actions
label: Actions
description: Actions are direct ways for users to respond to a comment, like “Flag” or “Reply.” Good actions are simple and meet common expectations from users.

name: reactionLabel
label: Reaction label
description: A reaction label describes the reaction users have to a comment, like “Like.” Good labels are clear, short, and simple.

name: reactionIcon
label: Reaction icon
description: A reaction icon is a visual symbol that pairs with the written label. Good icons are universal and easy to understand.

name: initialDisplayCount
label: Initial display count
description: An initial display count is the number of comments users see when this component first loads. A good display count allows users to see enough comments without feeling overwhelmed.
